79bc9c74dda49ea2.title: "Weird Al" Yankovic: UHF Live-to-Screen with Orchestra and Live Q&A
79bc9c74dda49ea2.desc: Weird Al brings his legendary full-production multimedia comedy rock show back to the concert stage with the BIGGER & WEIRDER 2025 Tour, playing his iconic hits as well as some never-performed-live-before fan favorites. Al’s long-time band is joined by four additional players to create a super-sized concert experience. “Weird Al” Yankovic is the biggest-selling comedy recording artist in history. A 5-time Grammy Award winner, he is best known for his parodies of the biggest musical artists over the last 4 decades.  His many hits include “Amish Paradise,” “Eat It,” “Like a Surgeon,” “Smells Like Nirvana,” “Word Crimes,” and the platinum-selling “White & Nerdy.”  His last album Mandatory Fun is the only comedy album in history to debut at #1 on the Billboard Top 200. Weird Al's live shows have entertained audiences across the globe for generations. In 2022, Yankovic produced and co-wrote the Emmy-winning biopic WEIRD: The Al Yankovic Story, starring Daniel Radcliffe in the title role.

79031cc3b5a39290.title: Studio Cabaret with Telephone Tag
79031cc3b5a39290.desc: With soaring harmonies, expressive violin, and rich acoustic textures, Telephone Tag creates a warm and immersive blend of contemporary folk-pop that is both intimate and emotionally resonant. Their music weaves together heartfelt lyrics, lush violin lines, and driving guitar rhythms, creating songs that feel cinematic yet deeply personal. Fresh off a major UK tour opening for 80s pop icons Johnny Hates Jazz (of “Shattered Dreams” fame), the couple continues to build an international following. Ryan’s career highlights include opening for Paul McCartney in London’s Hyde Park, while both artists have performed across the globe—from Dubai to stages throughout Europe and the U.S. Their recent EP and new singles showcase a sound that balances modern indie-folk with melodic pop sensibilities—music that invites audiences to lean in and truly listen. Whether delivering tender ballads or uplifting anthems, Telephone Tag’s sound is layered, dynamic, and filled with genuine feeling. 79cce800de11952f.title: Nest Healing Art Studio
79cce800de11952f.desc: HEALING ART STUDIO - FOR TEENS & ADULTS First Wednesday or Sunday of the Month, 1-2p ​​ NEST is a free, one-hour program dedicated to mindful, judgment-free art making. Guided by licensed art therapist Emily Skelton, each session begins with a calming meditation, followed by a demonstration of that day’s unique art project. Mindfulness in both meditation and art helps us regulate emotions, reduce stress, and focus our attention. Each week’s project is a surprise, revealed at the start of class to invite openness and curiosity. This gentle uncertainty is part of the healing process, helping us meet ourselves where we are, embrace vulnerability, and discover growth through creativity. No art experience is needed. You’ll be supported every step of the way in a safe, welcoming space for exploration and self-expression. Developed under the direction of Emily Skelton, LMFT, ATR-BC (to learn more about Emily, please go to her website). Notes This is a free, drop in program intended for teens and adults only. Please do not bring small children. Preregister to reserve your space and please let us know if you will not be able to attend. No shows will be removed from future registrations.
